## Packet information

Describe confirmed packet sizes, headers, padding, segmentation, timing, and acknowledgement behavior.

Do not post full unrelated USB captures. Remove serial numbers, usernames, and private paths.

## Testing availability

Can you test experimental source builds or portable builds on the physical device?

## Links and attachments

Add useful photos, short videos, documentation, packet excerpts, or scripts.
